description: This file defines the MediaThumbnailFormatter class, a Drupal plugin that formats media entity references as thumbnails with configurable link behavior.

classes.name: MediaThumbnailFormatter
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that formats media reference fields as thumbnails with optional linking to media or content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the formatter with dependencies and configuration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the formatter with services from the container.

methods.name: needsEntityLoad
methods.description: Overrides to determine if the entity needs to be loaded based on whether it is new.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Provides a form for configuring formatter settings, including link options.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Returns a summary of current formatter settings, indicating link type.

methods.name: viewElements
methods.description: Generates renderable elements for each media item, including thumbnail and link URL.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the formatter is applicable to a given field definition (target type 'media').

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for viewing the media entity.

methods.name: getMediaThumbnailUrl
methods.description: Determines the URL for the media thumbnail based on formatter settings.
